highlights.title: Sign in again opens the right row
highlights.text: When a connection needs you to sign in, "Sign in again" in a chat or the Inbox opens Settings on that connection, lit up, with its own Sign in again button ready.

highlights.title: A suggested connection shows its real state
highlights.text: The card for a connection a bot suggested says whether it's ready, needs you to sign in, or was removed in Settings, even after a reload or on another device.

highlights.title: A routine's chat card shows it as it is now
highlights.text: Move a routine to another time or pause it in Routines, and the chat card that made it follows: the new time, "Paused" with Resume, or a note once the routine is deleted.

fixes: Connecting an app a bot suggested opens a sheet named for the app, like "Google Search Console", not its internal code name.
A routine kwant retries on its own reads "Retried automatically" in History, and its failure is told once, not once per try.
A routine run whose question nobody answered reads "Needed your answer, didn’t finish" in History, not OK.
Routine runs in the Inbox now carry routine_id, the routine to run again; other items send it as null.
A failed routine run's Inbox row now shows what the bot said about the failure, not the raw tool error.
A paused routine now says Paused, not OK, and on a phone the routine switch and Open result are easy to tap.
Inbox summaries drop stray ** marks, and a routine that posts in a thread opens that thread from the Inbox and its notice.
